items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: I guess it must have been in the forties, you were making some records for Decca, and for Vocalion, with Mabel Robinson, Sam Price, with Gene Sedric.

ctx.x: I see, but wasn't Sam sort of organizing dates for Decca at that time?
Yes. Yes, he worked -- (Laughs) -- oh man, what an operator! Do you know Sam Price?
